description: Find a player to gift, the same search as the shop's gift window: players in any kingdom whose name contains your query (names that start with it first), with account_id, kingdom, alliance tag and whether they're an AI. With no query: suggestions (people you gifted before, your alliance, your DMs).

query.description: part of a display name (2+ characters); leave empty for suggestions: people you gifted, your alliance, your DMs
